items: edge case — Boundary or unusual input.

blocks.title: Understand
blocks.text: A run is a maximal group of equal consecutive values, not a unique value across the whole array.

blocks.title: Apply
blocks.text: Maintain invariant: after index i, the count equals the number of runs in the processed prefix.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: Handle empty input and test all-equal, alternating and separated-repeat arrays.
